meta_description: Beecroft Plumbing and Maintenance in Leicester. Emergency repairs, boiler installations, and maintenance. Fast response times. Call 07749 477116 for a quote.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Leicester? We're out within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to planned installations, we handle every plumbing need with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to resolve most issues the same day.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Servicing
services.desc: New boiler fitted with a 10-year warranty. Annual servicing keeps your heating running safely and efficiently.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Full system installation, repairs, and power flushing to restore heat and hot water throughout your home.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Complete bathroom refits from tiling to plumbing. We manage the whole job, leaving you with a finished space.

services.title: Drain Unblocking
services.desc: Blocked toilet, sink, or external drain cleared fast using rods or jet cleaning. Same-day visits available.

services.title: Maintenance & Preventative Care
services.desc: Regular inspections and maintenance programmes catch small problems before they become costly emergencies.

about_pullquote: I started this because I got tired of cowboys ripping off my neighbours.
about_para_1: Beecroft Plumbing and Maintenance was founded on a simple principle: honest work at a fair price. With over 15 years' experience across Leicester, we've built our reputation one job at a time. We're Gas Safe Registered and insured for all work, from emergency callouts to full system installations.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we show up when we say we will, explain the problem clearly, and charge what we quote—no surprises. We treat every home with the same care we'd give our own. That approach has earned us hundreds of repeat bookings and word-of-mouth referrals across Leicester.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe at 2am on a Sunday. Called Beecroft and the lad was here by 2:45, fixed it and stopped the flood. Wouldn't use anyone else now. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Got my boiler serviced and they found a hairline crack in the heat exchanger. Fixed it same day, explained everything in plain English, and the price was fair. Very impressed.
reviews.author: Christine K.

reviews.text: Beecroft fitted my new bathroom last summer. Professional, tidy, and on time. They sorted a drainage issue half-way through without any fuss. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.
